analysis_frame.scope: A conditional single five-coordinate gap, selected using a readable candidate. The source visibly has 193 slots against the printed 198, but does not mark the missing location.

records.readable_german: Festungsfunka Warschau. Das gesamte im Bereich des Gouvernements Warschau verfuegbare Funkerpersonal ist nach
records.meaning: The conditional first-part reconstruction orders all available radio personnel in the Warsaw government area to depart for the destination named by the native continuation.
notes: The raw output is conditional on a 198-slot frame with five unknown slots inserted at source boundary 165. It is not a native decode of the 193 printed slots.
The proposed complete stream changes observed A to V at source index 98, fills the printed dash at index 134 with D, and fills the five inserted slots with AAFFX. These costs are separate.

Against this exact 99-position candidate, all 194 possible insertion boundaries are checked. Boundary 165 is the unique minimum with one observed-coordinate substitution; this is a candidate-conditioned bound, not proof of unique historical text or damage.
The second part is directly read in its native frame and independently supplies the destination POSEN and the phrase IN MARSCH ZU SETZEN. It does not determine all missing first-part letters.

records.title: Warsaw radio personnel: native continuation naming Posen
records.header_literal: A) WAU v LP (03.55 p.m., November 15th); 14.50 2 TLE; 2 TL RICHI-144
records.readable_german: Festungsfunka Posen in Marsch zu setzen. I Nach Funkleitung Heimat Nr ???6?5.
records.meaning: The continuation names Festungsfunka Posen as the destination and says to set the personnel in motion. The transmitted I NACH and final numerical labels remain unexpanded.
notes: This complete native 144-slot part decodes with no coordinate change or source-mask fill. The final six-symbol reference ???6?5 remains coupled through the unchanged partial square.
The source prints VD AVD with an internal space; all five letters are retained. Word spacing and omission of separator X labels are display changes only.
The sequence INACH is not silently changed to NACH or I A.

records.title: A second physical witness of the December-key and IRRTUM notice
records.header_literal: B) NKJ v LP (04.24 p.m., November 15th); 10.00 (15/11); RIZI-124-
records.readable_german: Unloesbare Funksprueche nach Dezemberschluessel entziffern. Irrtum.
records.meaning: A repeat source of the p189 C instruction to decipher otherwise unreadable telegrams using the December key. The separate final word Irrtum is retained without assigning it a procedural meaning.
notes: All 124 native source slots are retained. The first two editorial words cost three observed-coordinate substitutions and no erasure fill.

The source differs from p189 C at one coordinate. That other raw copy supports only the B at plaintext index 6; the proposed R at 8 and F at 10 are shared editorial repairs and receive no new independent raw support from this duplicate.
The trailing dash in RIZI-124- belongs to the length label, not the body. The final printed XFXX was omitted by earlier OCR and is restored from the source image.

prior_credit: Published period keys: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), and George Lasry (2017 key list). Earlier repository OCR and unchanged-key outputs are retained separately. Source review and explicit editorial work: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro. No universal first-decipherment priority is asserted.
limits: p197 A1 uses a conditional five-slot gap model; the source deficit alone does not locate the gap.
Gap optimality is conditioned on one declared candidate and the single-gap family; it is not a global or historical uniqueness theorem.
Other source records are native frames. Every observed-coordinate change, source-mask fill and inserted-slot fill is priced separately.
Published key cells remain unchanged and coupled globally; numerical labels retain their raw values.
Repeated damaged copies do not independently support editorial wording shared by both.
